entities.summary: Dimitar Kutrovsky is a retired tennis player from Bulgaria. On 18 May 2015, he reached his highest ATP singles ranking of 293 whilst his best doubles ranking was 234 on 10 August 2015. Dimitar Kutrovsky was a athletes & competitors from Sofia (b. 1987-08-27, Sofia). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
